title: Insecure Django setting (python) — review required
description: A Django security setting is left open: ALLOWED_HOSTS = []. Django's secure defaults exist to be switched on for deployment; the open value weakens host validation, transport, or cookie handling. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms local-only scope or hardens it.
remediation: Set the deployment value (the real host list) outside local settings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of settings module.
